series.label: NEON BIGC · area-normalized runoff
series.aggregation: daily mean discharge converted to mm/day; at least 90% valid temporal coverage
series.time_basis: UTC days; 15-minute intervals assigned by start; legacy instantaneous 1-minute values assigned by timestamp
series.notes: Discharge is a rating-curve estimate. Use finite nonnegative values with automated quality flag 0 and science-review flag 0 or blank. Blank science-review flags mean unreviewed; these counts are retained. Daily values with 90–100% coverage estimate a full-day rate from the valid observations; gaps are not zero-filled. Legacy 1-minute instantaneous data are averaged with equal 60-second weights. Source correction indicators are summarized; unreviewed provisional estimates may change. Area normalization uses NEON’s approximate 10.9 km² catchment area. BIGC is a regional comparison, not discharge from Soaproot or Newt Creek.

source_notes: Upper Big Creek (BIGC) is a separate NEON catchment near Soaproot Saddle, not the measured runoff of Soaproot or Newt Creek.
Catchment area ≈10.9 km² from the NEON BIGC site description: https://www.neonscience.org/field-sites/bigc
Daily runoff rate = mean discharge in L/s × 0.0864 / drainage area in km². Values require at least 90% valid daily coverage.
Automated quality failures and science-review failures are excluded. Blank science-review flags are unreviewed and retained explicitly in daily quality counts.
Older 1-minute instantaneous estimates and newer 15-minute averages have distinct processing histories. Exact table and release are recorded per month.
Provisional discharge can lag meteorology and may use rating curves carried forward from an earlier water year. Daily availability checks do not imply live data.
Raw CSVs and cached summaries stay on the Raspberry Pi. Released months refresh when the release changes; provisional months are rechecked daily.
